article.title: The AI model distillation paradox
article.author: Editor
article.content: When U.S. labs train models on the world’s writing, Washington calls it fair use. When Chinese labs train on U.S. outputs, it’s a “malicious attack.” It can’t have it both ways. The post The AI model distillation paradox appeared first on MR Online .
